responsibility: Defines RTL instruction patterns for the RISC-V vector bfloat16 extensions. It covers predicated BF16 truncation from FP32, BF16 widening conversion back to FP32, and BF16 widening multiply-accumulate forms with rounding-mode handling and mode-family iteration, providing the machine-description layer for Zvfbfmin and Zvfbfwma vector BF16 operations distinct from the generic RVV floating-point patterns.
